author: Joltz_
body:
So I've always wanted this feature, Signatures. You see them alot around other forums, and the reason I want this is because
a)They can be Humorous.
and
b)They tell us about the players personality. 
and
c)They're that players personal Trademark 

They're like the About tab in your Profile. But summarized and cool features thanks to HTML

Then if you think they're too "Overrated" They'res this Personal text. What they do is like a Quote you like, a Passage of text you enjoy. Not as many forums has "Personalized Text" than ones with Signatures. But Just like signatures they can be,
a)They can be Humorous. 
and
b)They tell us about the players personality. 
and
c)They're that players personal Trademark 

Done. :)
